decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed for 'Backpacks' is heavily populated with irrelevant items such as camping stoves, wood-burning pots, and bicycle helmets, which makes for a frustrating shopping experience. Within the actual bags listed, the options are almost entirely specialized for specific activities—fishing, baseball gear, ski boots, or hydration—rather than general-purpose use. The only high-end general tactical option (Maxpedition) is priced quite high at $171, while the more affordable tactical shoulder bag has mixed reviews regarding its zipper durability. Since none of the products provide a good balance of general utility, quality, and price, I have decided not to make a purchase.
